Specification: Yo-Yo distributed leader-election algorithm (Santoro) on an arbitrary undirected, strongly-connected, loop-free graph parameterised by Nodes and Edges, without the pruning optimisation. The node with the smallest integer identity is elected leader. Each round runs a down phase (sources broadcast their identity, internal nodes forward the minimum) and an up phase (sinks reply yes/no, edges flip on no), eventually reaching a stable single-source state but without explicit termination detection. Includes TypeOK, NeighborInv, NoNewSource invariants and Liveness = <>[]Stabilization.
AssumptionNames: /\ Nodes \subseteq Int /\ Nodes # {} /\ LET G == [node |-> Nodes, edge |-> Edges] IN /\ IsUndirectedGraph(G) /\ IsStronglyConnected(G)
IfThenElse: IF incoming[n] = {} THEN "source" ELSE IF outgoing[n] = {} THEN "sink" ELSE "internal"
